text: {"lessons":["I tend to sell stocks once they show a gain, as I did with D, C, E, A and B; I should consider each stock’s prospects rather than treat a gain as a reason by itself to sell.","Selling B at a gain felt good, but I should not let that satisfaction make me hold other positions just to avoid admitting a loss.","Buying back into all five stocks in Period 4 did not prevent my account from falling 7.3% by Period 5; I should weigh risk and diversification across the whole portfolio, not just each stock separately."]}
